This in turn introduces additional complexity to the DST optics by requiring point- to-point optics between the kicker and the target. Reducing and/or eliminating the delay line isolation would improve the flattop and reduce the challenges in tuning the DST. The ASD/Scorpius project is not planning to have any delay line isolation; DARHT could benefit from lessons learned here. downstream.
